Class Warrior

java.lang.Object
model.entity.base.CharacterModel
model.entity.base.PlayerCharacter
model.entity.concrete.Warrior
public class Warrior extends PlayerCharacter
Represents a Warrior-type playable character.

Warriors are strong melee fighters with high health and defense. This class extends PlayerCharacter and adds the ability to equip and unequip a Sword.

  • Method Details

    • equipSword

      public void equipSword(Sword sword)
      Equips a sword to the Warrior. If the Warrior already has a sword equipped, that sword is first unequipped. Then the new sword is equipped by calling its Equipable.use(PlayerCharacter) method.
      Parameters:
      sword - the sword the Warrior wants to equip.

    • unequipSword

      public void unequipSword(Sword sword)
      Unequips the given sword from the Warrior. The sword is removed only if it is the one currently equipped. No action is performed otherwise.
      Parameters:
      sword - the sword to remove from the Warrior.
